datasets.title: Indonesia - West Sulawesi EQ - Shake Map (6.2 RS)
datasets.description: This data contain of shake information caused by Earthquake M 6.2 - 32 km S of Mamuju, Indonesia (2.976°S 118.901°E) at 2021-01-14 18:28:18 (UTC). [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/6-2-sr-shakemap-of-majene-earthquake]

lineage.description: USGS generated a shakemap from the 2021-01-14 magnitude 6.2 earthquake near Mamuju, Indonesia, producing observed Modified Mercalli Intensity (MMI) values across the affected region. The data was compiled into a spatial dataset with MMI classifications and associated metadata for disaster risk assessment.

sources.name: USGS
sources.description: United States Geological Survey earthquake shakemap data providing observed ground motion intensity measurements from the 6.2 magnitude earthquake event
